hook: AI gave me a 7-step framework when I just needed someone to tell me what to do.
caption:
AI gave me a 7-step framework when I just needed someone to tell me what to do.

I was overwhelmed. Deadline in 2 hours. I asked ChatGPT for help prioritizing my day and it came back with a color-coded priority matrix and a Eisenhower quadrant breakdown.

I wanted a drill sergeant. I got a consultant.

That's not an AI problem. That's a *calibration* problem.

Some people think in systems. Give them the framework, they'll run.

Some people (hi) need someone to just say: "Do this first. Then this. Stop overthinking."

Same question. Completely different useful answer — depending on how your brain actually works.

This is what we built BootFile for. Not to make AI smarter. To make it stop treating everyone like the same person.

Your BootFile tells AI whether you want the map or just the next turn. Whether you process by talking it out or by seeing a clean list. Whether "be direct" means bullet points or means skip the preamble entirely.

The AI isn't broken. It just doesn't know you yet.
